disclaimer: Curated snapshot for a hackathon demo. Not a legal determination. Rules change; confirm with the carrier and the official destination authority.

items.label: Aerosol / pressurized container
items.reason: Pressurized containers are restricted by air carriers and postal operators. Confirm the carrier's dangerous-goods policy before shipping.

items.label: Lithium battery / power bank
items.reason: Loose or installed lithium cells are subject to dangerous-goods and watt-hour limits. Carrier approval may be required.

items.label: Meat, dairy, or animal products
items.reason: Animal products can carry quarantine risk and are commonly prohibited or require an import permit or certificate.

items.label: Plants, seeds, or fresh produce
items.reason: Plant material is subject to phytosanitary controls and may require inspection or a certificate.

items.label: Prescription medicine or supplements
items.reason: Medicine and some supplements have prescription, permit, or quantity limits. Confirm with the destination authority.

items.label: Alcohol
items.reason: Alcohol is restricted in international mail, has duty and tax implications, and may require a licence.

items.label: Counterfeit goods or currency
items.reason: Counterfeit goods and currency are prohibited. Shipments may be seized and the sender may face penalties.
